question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the experimental Claws core lifecycle and allow this workspace-file mutation slice to proceed with its stacked parent PRs?
rationale: This is a new persistent core lifecycle and manifest-driven mutation surface; correctness evidence cannot decide whether that product direction belongs in OpenClaw core.

options.title: Pause pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep this protected stacked PR open but do not merge or dispatch further implementation work until an authorized maintainer explicitly accepts the Claws core direction.

options.title: Sponsor the stack
options.body: Accept the experimental lifecycle direction and review this PR together with its open schema and root-install parent slices before landing in stack order.

options.title: Decline core scope
options.body: Close the implementation stack if the Claws lifecycle should not become an OpenClaw core feature.

recommendation.title: Pause pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this protected stacked PR open but do not merge or dispatch further implementation work until an authorized maintainer explicitly accepts the Claws core direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared-state ownership history and prior review context make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the core lifecycle and persistence decision.
